protocol: normal-only shortlist and view freeze before injection; three fixed targeted seeds, 60 degrees / 0.18 m; first automatic pass; no model selection

normal_shortlist.reason: Single large laptop panel; unobstructed hinge motion. Mid crosses signed range; rest not necessarily closed.
Single large dishwasher door; clear body attachment and opening arc; limit may approach frame boundary.
Single broad drawer front translates against fixed cabinet; normal motion smaller but visible.
Single large box panel; direct hinge opening; signed symmetric limits make mid equal rest.
Single large display panel on fixed stand; visible tilt, little occlusion.
Single broad USB sliding component; large translational travel and clear housing.
Kettle moving handle is thin, occluded; body dominates normal frames.
Folding chair has thin intersecting frame and less intuitive motion despite one joint.
Three drawers but only one actuated; broad drawer box and clear slide, other joints fixed at rest; lower priority than single joint.
Two joints but chosen large door panel has clear opening against fixed frame; secondary joint stays rest.
